raw_segments.text: When I had exhausted the garden and a greenhouse with nothing in it but a fallen-down grapevine
and some bottles, I found myself in the dismal corner upon which I had looked out of the
Never questioning for a moment that the house was now empty, I looked in at another window
and found myself, to my great surprise, exchanging a broad stare with a pale young gentleman
with red eyelids and light hair.
